items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: I don’t play classical music like Mozart, because I wasn’t trained like that

ctx.x: Are you a keyboard player also?
I could get around. I don’t play classical music like Mozart, because I wasn’t trained like that, but I can certainly — I play what’s called arranger’s piano.
